introduction.fields: I study computer-science and science in general for few years by myself. I learn from AIs, courses, books, curriculums, documentations…

introduction.practice: I develop web interfaces, applications, smart-contracts…

skills.fundamentals: Fundamentals: C, Operational Systems (Windows, Linux, Android), Algorithms, Data Structures, Web (IP/TCP, HTTPS), Hardware
skills.front-end: Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript → React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Next.js, Playwright, ESLint
skills.back-end: Back-end: Python → Django, JavaScript → Node.js, Express → Next.js → next-intl
skills.web-3-front-end: Web-3 Front-end: Viem, Wagmi, ethers.js, RainbowKit, Connect Kit, App Kit
skills.deployment: Deployment: Vercel, Husky, lint-staged, Open Graph, Search Engine Optimization
skills.tools: Tools: Docker, Git, GitHub, Notion, Visual Studio Code, Prettier
skills.artificial-intellegence: Artificial Intellegence: LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Claude), Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot
skills.soft-skills: Soft-skills: Communication, Discipline, Education, Health and Activity, Information Diving
skills.additional: Additional: Design → Photos, Web-design, Drawing; Music → Guitar; Sports → Wrestling; Writing → Poetry, Philosophy essays
